svg.text: GSM/GPS Tracker - ESP32-C3 Super Mini wiring (matches carrier PCB v2)
C1, C2 next to SIM800L VCC
All GND pins are connected together.
SIM800L runs straight from the cell (VBAT).
Never feed it 5 V or 3.3 V from the ESP32.
Peaks of 2 A: short, thick VBAT/GND wires,
C1 1000 uF right at its VCC pin.
SIM800L RXD is 2.8 V logic, so ESP TX goes
through the R1/R2 divider. TXD is direct.
GPIO2 is a strapping pin; SIM800L RST
pulls it high, so boot is safe.
Arduino: USB CDC On Boot = Enabled.
The board has no protection between USB
5 V and the 5V pin: switch SW1 OFF while
USB is plugged in, or fit a 1N5819
diode from MT3608 OUT+ to the 5V pin.
Charge the cell outside the board
